ci90.tail_definition: two-sided percentile interval from the shared paired draws

lower95.tail_definition: one-sided lower fifth percentile from the same paired draws; do not resample a second time

metric_labels.pooled_slu_micro_f1: slu_f1_micro (pooled official SLU F1 from saved sufficient counts)
metric_labels.row_mean_slu_f1: slu_f1_f1 (mean of per-row official SLU F1)

populations.construction: NEW500 is the existing DEV-1000-NEW500 receipt. OLD500 is the full DEV1000 set difference. DEV1000 is the pooled full receipt. Do not redraw a population or promote a secondary population to primary.

shared_fixed_top3_source.analysis_role: Separate source-bound diagnostic input. It is not a scored arm and must never be placed under analysis.inputs for score_compare_cli.

analysis_runner.mode: default saved-score path with explicit complete-score receipts for derived-delivery-v1 bundles; do not use generic-scores-v1

authorization_state: HELD. This recipe defines a future saved-score analysis only. It does not authorize source generation, successor generation, fitting, scoring, a new roster, a candidate-width sweep, semantic result reads, or a new autonomous system claim.
binding_state: DRAFT ONLY, HELD. The common fixed-Top-3 source and both successor bundles are future bindings. Root must replace every pending path/hash after finalization and first complete official scoring, register the read release, and review before any semantic result read.

diagnostics_after_registered_release.implementation_boundary: score_compare_cli emits only verified saved-score projections and paired intervals; source Top-1/Top-3, conditional rescue/harm, shortlist, refusal and trace error diagnostics require a separate source-bound read over the verified manifests/phase_sources/trace and are not produced by the generic scorer path.
branch_integrity: hard-first attempted revision and whether its final intent changed
branch refusal and empty final delivery
malformed JSON/entity structure and output saturation
candidate counts and candidate-contract view calls
conditional_commitment: rank-one intent wrong and CLOSED_JOINT final intent correct: rescue
rank-one intent correct and CLOSED_JOINT final intent wrong: harm or spoil
rank-one intent wrong and final remains wrong
rank-one intent correct and final remains correct
gold intent retained but not selected
selected intent correct with wrong entities

cost_and_input_quantities.interpretation: Use sealed manifest cost fields and registered contact records. Do not infer generation quantity or efficacy from power, wall time, or tool availability.
per_arm_required: prompt and completion token totals when sealed cost metadata supplies them
extra successor contact count relative to the common source

entity_and_event: slot/entity extraction and ownership failures conditional on intent status
OBS, ORG, SUPPLY and USE event counts when present in the sealed trace schema
diagnostics_after_registered_release.read_rule: Read diagnostics only after both bundles are FINALIZED and COMPLETED, both first official scores are hash-bound, the analysis source pins are replaced, and root records the semantic read release.
source: candidate-set coverage by scenario and stratum
source parse, empty, malformed, duplicate, illegal-ID and saturation outcomes

candidate_flag.condition: Set exploratory_candidate=true only when the NEW500 paired speaker-clustered CI90 lower endpoint for slu_f1_micro is greater than zero AND the CI90 lower endpoint for scenario_action_exact is greater than or equal to zero.
candidate_flag.otherwise: Preserve the label negative or inconclusive according to the requested interval and report all metric tradeoffs.
candidate_flag.primary_basis: The pooled micro SLU F1 interval is the primary outcome; the intent interval is a guard against an isolated slot-only gain.

interpretation.correlation: The shared source, roster, speech packets and candidate contracts intentionally correlate the paired observations; this is not an independent replication.
interpretation.inconclusive: The requested interval crosses zero or the guard cannot be evaluated; retain the label and report point estimates, intervals and decomposition.
interpretation.negative: The requested interval is wholly below zero for the named metric; report the component result without a superiority or generalization claim.
interpretation.positive: Exploratory component evidence only. It does not admit the mechanism or establish an autonomous system effect.
interpretation.replication_rule: A positive component result requires replication on the same roster or a root-cause to a named registered component before another mechanism or roster is admitted.

method_contract.pooled_micro_rule: Compute slu_f1_micro from the declared saved word/character TP, FP and FN fields. Never substitute a mean of row F1 values.
method_contract.primary_estimand: paired speaker-clustered bootstrap delta with 10000 draws and seed 20260913
method_contract.row_mean_rule: Report slu_f1_f1 as the mean of per-row official SLU F1. Never label it pooled micro F1.
secondary_estimands: row-mean SLU F1, reported separately from pooled micro F1
intent, scenario and action exact accuracy
method_contract.sign: closed_joint minus hard_first; higher quality is positive

output.result_read_release: Root records a separate release before reading semantic results.
output.source_bindings: Root replaces every pending source, manifest and attached-score hash with measured values after seals.

purpose.common_source: Both branches consume the same finalized source artifact, ordered three-candidate state, candidate-contract view bytes, speech packet and task contract.
purpose.comparison: HARD_FIRST versus CLOSED_JOINT after one common scoreless fixed-Top-3 hypothesis source
purpose.component_scope: intent commitment timing and joint intent-slot resolution under identical ordered candidates and candidate contracts
purpose.not_an_autonomous_system_claim: This is a controlled component comparison. It is not evidence for autonomous tool selection, a decomposition gain beyond the extra contact, complete-system superiority, or an independent replication. The common source makes the paired observations correlated.

score_source_contract.no_projection: Use the raw slurp-slu-official result and retain its declared per-row fields plus the six pooled count fields. Do not alter estimator semantics.
source_order: verify the common fixed-Top-3 source and both derived-delivery-v1 successor bundles
score each complete derived-delivery manifest exactly once through core.scoring_batch with --include-per-sample; do not finalize a delivery derivative
verify the resulting complete score receipt bytes without invoking a scorer again
replace the future manifest and complete-score-receipt path/hash/cell placeholders
run score_compare_cli once with zero new scorer invocations
release semantic comparison only after both branch receipts and derived bundles are verified

source_analysis_plan.source_status: The source is a scoreless fixed-3 artifact on the DEV1000 roster. Preserve its raw response and bind its canonical sample, schema, semantics, candidate order, candidate-contract source and response hashes after sealing. The branch score manifests are saea-derived-delivery-v1 bundles; their raw generation parents remain unscored.
